meta.title: A rejection through the status endpoint never blocks re-bidding
gaps: The buyer's status-endpoint rejection cannot be expressed because no operation or case-owned request provides its method, path, and body; the re-bid step therefore cannot be verified in the required post-rejection state.

words.preconditions: A fresh published RFQ event where the invited QA vendor has submitted a bid; bidding still open.
steps: The invited QA vendor places a complete bid (open, price, submit).
As the buyer, read the pricing round and check that the round counts the new bid.
words.expected: The app accepts it. Read back afterwards: the round counts the new bid.

plan.title: A rejection through the status endpoint never blocks re-bidding

assert.say: the round counts the new bid
